comment: LEVEL 1 and ALGORITHM each do a second job. In the internal oscillator algorithms Warps.cpp:96 reads LEVEL 1 as the oscillator's pitch at twelve semitones per volt, normalled to 2V when nothing is patched. In the frequency shifter algorithm Warps.cpp:94 reads ALGORITHM a second time, on its own and clamped to ±5V, as the shift amount.
